# ellipog.dev

> Minecraft mods for Fabric and NeoForge, and their manuals.

Ellipog builds Minecraft mods. Three are in development: Tenet, a visual questing
engine (JSON quest files in, a pannable canvas out; the server decides what
counts as done), Armature, a shared library mod (one loader seam, a strict JSON
reader, and a client UI toolkit for layout, text, shapes, themes and widgets),
and Stature, a scale and anatomy API (per-entity size and proportions, hitboxes
that follow, 40+ channels, frames and a server-authoritative API with events).
Earlier released work (addons and packs) is listed on the home page.
Everything published is on Modrinth and CurseForge. Target versions: Minecraft
26.3 on Fabric and NeoForge.

## Docs

- [Home](https://ellipog.dev/): catalog, download counts, author links
- [Documentation](https://ellipog.dev/docs/): every manual, written in the mod's
  own repository and synced at build time
- [Tenet documentation](https://ellipog.dev/docs/tenet/): quest authoring,
  quest files, tasks, rewards, conditions, validation, KubeJS scripting, HUD
- [Armature documentation](https://ellipog.dev/docs/armature/): API (data,
  teams), client toolkit (layout, panels, shapes, text, themes, widgets)
- [Stature documentation](https://ellipog.dev/docs/stature/): scale and
  anatomy API, channels, frames, commands, events
- [Glossary](https://ellipog.dev/docs/glossary/): terms used across the mods
